title: Solaris · Solplanet solar monitoring
description: Local inverter telemetry from the Solaris Prometheus exporter.

options.content: **Select a Prometheus data source, target and inverter using the filters above.** Live telemetry is shown only for fresh samples. Energy and operating time are last-known counters; daily energy uses the inverter's local calendar day. Prometheus history starts with the first scrape.

panels.title: Exporter reachable
panels.description: Prometheus scrape health, independent of inverter freshness.

panels.title: Inverter data freshness
panels.description: Based on stored sample age; not a direct network probe.

panels.title: Energy today
panels.description: Last-known counter for the current inverter-local day. Absent after midnight until a new sample.

panels.title: Daily energy counter
panels.description: A gauge that resets daily; do not use with rate() or increase().

panels.title: Energy in selected range
panels.description: Prometheus increase() estimate from scraped counters; may extrapolate at range boundaries.

panels.title: Observed AC peak in range
panels.description: Peak observed by Prometheus; peaks between scrapes may be missed.

panels.title: Calculated AC/DC ratio
panels.description: Only with DC ≥100 W and 0 < AC ≤ DC. Not a certified efficiency measurement.

panels.title: Reported power factor
panels.description: The value reported by the inverter; distinct from the AC/DC ratio.

panels.title: Fault code
panels.description: Raw manufacturer code; 0 = no reported fault.

panels.title: Warning code
panels.description: Raw manufacturer code; 0 = no reported warning.

panels.title: Operating flag
panels.description: Raw flg value, without an inferred status mapping.

panels.title: Data freshness over time
panels.description: 1 = fresh, 0 = old or missing. Sleeping inverters may show stale data at night.
